title: Collections contact policy
content:
Reminders go only to invoices past their due date. Each reminder names the invoice, the amount now due and the due date, and asks when payment can be expected.
At least 7 days between reminders to the same customer.
No reminder on an invoice with an open dispute, or with an open promise to pay whose date has not passed.
A contact marked do-not-contact is never contacted, on any channel. If no contact on an account may be reached, the account goes to the AR lead.
Where a customer's channel is set to review, a person approves each message before it is sent.
Messages are polite and factual and never threaten.
